### Chairman & Managing Director

## Gopal Srinivasan

Gopal Srinivasan is the Chairman and Managing Director of TVS Capital Funds (TCF). TCF — a growth private equity platform set up in 2007, is the largest Indian rupee capital Fund in India, with a corpus of ₹2,000 Crores. Under the leadership of Gopal, the platform has invested in more than 30 businesses that include companies like Nykaa, RBL, National Stock Exchange (NSE), Indian Energy Exchange (IEX), GoDigit, Yubi and Five Star Business Finance.

Gopal is a third-generation member of the illustrious TVS Family; his entrepreneurial career spanning well over three decades, in which he has founded, steered and scaled up over 10 new ventures across diverse verticals.

Gopal also believes that the key for building the new India is to energize educational institutions. He has contributed significantly to his alma mater. Gopal is a member of University of Michigan’s Ross School of Business Advisory Board. Gopal was also associated as a Governing Board member of Great Lakes Institute of Management-Chennai, IFMR- Chennai and Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA), Chennai.

Gopal has played an extensive role in VC/PE industry bodies as well as regulatory policy landscape. He is a board member of the Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA). Gopal has been a member of SEBI’s Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC), since 2016 and he is also a board member of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), since its inception in Dec’20.

He actively involves in promoting start-ups and Founding member of The Chennai Angels, TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs), Chennai and Non-official member of National Start-up Advisory Council (NSAC) being formed by the DPITT

Gopal’s pursuit of excellence in creating an environment of intellectual and creative engagement in his hometown of Chennai led him to yet another initiative to bring together diverse groups of people under the auspices of the Chennai International Center (CIC). As its chairman, he has sought to develop CIC into a think tank that brings together a cornucopia of thought leaders from business, economy, policy, science, art, culture, and governing bodies.

**Organizational Positions**

- Chairman and Managing Director, TVS Capital Funds P Ltd
- Chairman of TVS Electronics Ltd
- Director on the Board of TVS & Sons and few other companies in and outside the TVS Group

Gopal is the Honorary Consul General for the Kingdom of Netherlands in Tamil Nadu, in recognition of his standing in the Community.

**Board Positions: Academics**

- Member, Ross School of Business Advisory Board at the University of Michigan, USA
- Former Chairman of the University of Michigan’s India Advisory Board
- Former member, Governing Councils at: Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA);
- Great Lakes Institute of Management; IFMR School of Management

**Board Positions: Private Equity / Venture Capital & Advisory Councils**

- Non-official member on the National Start-up Advisory Council (NSAC) being formed by the DPITT
- Board member of Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH)
- Member, Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC) of SEBI since March 2015
- Former Chairman of IVCA (Indian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association): 2016-2018
- Former Chairman, of Confederation of Indian Industry’s (CII) National Committee for Private Equity & Venture Capital (2009-2011) and Former Chairman of CII Tamil Nadu State Council (2007-2008)
- Founding member of The Chennai Angels
- Founding member of TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs), Chennai
- Chairman, Forge CIBI (a Technology Accelerator & Incubator) hosted at the Kumaraguru

**Education**

- Com, Loyola College, Chennai & MBA from Graduate School of Bus. Admn. University of Michigan, USA

### Managing Partner

## Naveen Unni

Naveen Unni is Managing Partner at TCF. With nearly two decades of consulting experience at McKinsey, Naveen brings a wealth of knowledge and leadership to our team. His diverse background across multiple geographies, including India, Australia, and Southeast Asia, positions him as a key driver of investments and portfolio management across various verticals.

Naveen’s extensive experience spans a wide range of sectors, with a particular focus on the industrial landscape. He has worked with manufacturing, mining, oil & gas, infrastructure, and utility companies on a large scale. His invaluable insights and strategic guidance have propelled these organizations forward in India, Southeast Asia, and Australia.

Beyond his expertise in business strategy, Naveen has also made significant contributions in leadership development, top team effectiveness, business transformation, and digital transformation. This comprehensive skill set grants him a unique perspective in evaluating investments and supporting the NextGen entrepreneurs who aspire to build high-quality businesses.

Prior to joining TVS Capital Funds, Naveen held multiple leadership roles at McKinsey and Company, a renowned consulting firm. As the Managing Partner of the Chennai location, he also led the India sustainability practice, which he founded and led the support functions for the India office. In addition, he served as the Managing Partner of the Perth location, leading the Australian Electric Power and Natural Gas practice and the Australian Organization practice, both of which he initiated.

Naveen holds an MBA from the prestigious Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, and a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from the esteemed Indian Institute of Technology Madras. Recognized for his expertise and contributions, he sits on the advisory boards of the University of Western Australia Business School, Perth, and KC High School, Chennai. Additionally, Naveen is an esteemed member of the YPO Chennai Chapter, fostering connections and collaborations within the business community.

Outside of his professional pursuits, Naveen finds joy in various hobbies. He is an avid reader, enjoys word puzzles, and listens to rock, jazz and R&B music. Naveen also finds time to play bridge and badminton, and occasionally picks up his guitar. He cherishes moments with his wife and two daughters, exploring new places through their travels. Moreover, he is passionate about mentoring young individuals, guiding them to discover their own paths in life.

Naveen Unni, a remarkable leader, strategic advisor, and passionate individual, embodies the values and spirit of TVS Capital Funds. His expertise, dedication, and unwavering support make him an invaluable asset as we embark on a journey to shape a brighter future for entrepreneurs and businesses alike.

![Praveen Sridharan - Partner TVS Capital Funds](https://www.tvscapital.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Praveen-ACPC-Shot.png)

### Partner

## Praveen Sridharan

Praveen Sridharan is a Partner at TCF. He works across the investment and platform teams helping them drive origination, transactions, portfolio management and fund raising.

He is an investment professional with 14+ years of experience across buy side and sell side roles. He has worked across the lifecycle of investments including transaction sourcing, evaluation, negotiations, deal structuring, due diligence, documentation, portfolio management and exits.

Prior to joining TCF, he worked as a Director at Emerald India, a pan-Asia investment platform set-up by the global PE firm Kohlberg Kravis and Roberts (KKR). He also played an active role in the setting up of the Emerald platform.

Praveen has also worked with Ambit Corporate Finance, which gave him M&A and Private Equity exposure and with Cognizant Technology Solutions which gave him exposure to the technology side of businesses.

Praveen is an MBA from Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore and an engineering graduate from Indian Institute of Technology, Madras. He enjoys listening to old rock classics but is a recent convert to fusion music too.

![](https://www.tvscapital.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/9-2x-500x500.webp)

### Partner

## Chandrasekar V

Chandra brings more than two decades of experience with McKinsey specializing in building, transforming and leading at-scale high performance research teams with a strong track record of innovation and capability building

As the Leader of McKinsey’s Client Capabilities Hubs in Chennai and Bangalore (both of which he helped set up) that house close to 300 colleagues comprising analysts, experts, data scientists and solution builders, Chandra was responsible for setting long term strategic direction, fostering innovation, enhancing Reach & Relevance, and enabling cross pollination of best practices amongst different teams

Chandra was also the Leader of one of the largest research teams in McKinsey that conducts broad and deep research across topics, functions, and geographies. In this role, he was responsible for setting the vision and strategy for the team, generating client demand, managing client delivery and day to day operations and talent and performance management

Prior to these, Chandra was a Knowledge Specialist in the TMT sector where he has served as a thought partner to McKinsey teams worldwide delivering deep expertise across technology topics

He holds an MBA in Information Systems from University of Bombay and Chemical Engineering from University of Madras.

Chandra loves quizzing, is an avid motorsports enthusiast and also enjoys reading and music.

![](https://www.tvscapital.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/45-2x-500x500.webp)

### Principal

## Rajalakshmi Vaidyanathan

Rajalakshmi is a Principal with TCF. She brings with her, more than 12 years of experience in the financial services domain in roles spanning debt and equity markets. In her last assignment, she was Regional Head (South) of L&T Financial Services, responsible for P&L of the wholesale business in Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka. Prior to L&T Finance, she was a part of the Investment Banking team of SBI Capital Markets, where she has extensive experience in end-to-end management of capital market transactions.

Rajalakshmi is an MBA from IIFT (Delhi) and also holds a bachelor’s degree in mathematics from the University of Madras.

She has been a professional classical dancer, having learnt the art for more than 15 years. She is passionate about dance and music. Come December, you can catch her in the Chennai music/dance circles! Raji (as most people call her) also loves travelling and baking desserts. She spends her weekends doing fun and recreational activities with her kids.

Suraj is a Principal at TVS Capital. Prior to joining the team, he worked with the middle office of UBS Investment Bank and focused on Healthcare transactions in US and EMEA regions

Suraj graduated as an Industrial Engineer from NIT Trichy, where he served leadership roles in its cultural festival and Robotics club. ### Managing Partner

## Krishna Ramachandran

Krishna Ramachandran is Managing Partner at TCF.

Krishna comes with more than 30 years of experience across client engagement, business transformation, digital transformation, finance and operations.

Till recently, he was Managing Director at Accenture responsible for their Chennai Operations. He has also been associated with Royal Philips, Allianz, KPMG and Vodafone in multiple roles.

Krishna comes with a wide spectrum of operating experience including significant exposure to digital transformation initiatives. His multi-disciplinary experience across businesses will help drive value to TCF portfolio companies. It also significantly strengthens TCF’s internal initiatives in building a “neo TCF”, which will help scale the fund to the next level.

Krishna is also a public speaker on the subjects of Corporate Governance, Digitisation, Robotics Process Automation and finance transformation, and is also an Executive Coach and visiting faculty.

His interests include Cycling, Yoga, Ikebana among others and is always eager to learn and explore.

Krishna is a qualified Chartered Accountant, Management Accountant and a Company Secretary.

### Former Vice Chairman

## D. Sundaram

D. Sundaram was the former Vice Chairman & CFO of HUL with 34 years of professional experience in corporate finance, business performance, governance, talent management and strategy.

He is an institution builder and is closely associated with shaping great businesses in TVS Capital’s portfolio. He anchors the TVS Capital platform and its transformation to an institution. He brings deep financial expertise and significant understanding of consumer-related businesses to the PE operations.

Sundaram serves as an Independent Director on the eminent boards of Infosys, ACC, GSK Pharma India, Crompton Greaves Consumer, SBI General Insurance and Schneider Electric India Pvt Ltd. He is a two-time winner of the prestigious “CFO of the Year for FMCG Sector” award by CNBC TV18 (2006 and 2008). Also awarded as the “Best Independent Director in 2019” by Asian Centre for Corporate Governance and Sustainability in December 2020.

He is a Post Graduate of Management Studies (MMS), a Fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants, and an alumnus of the Harvard Business School.

### Former ED & CFO

### Ex-Morgan Stanley India CEO, Chairman, InKlude Labs

## Narayan Ramachandran

Narayan Ramachandran is the Chairman of TeamLease Services, India’s leading provider of human resource services.

Narayan also serves as the co-Chairman of Unitus Capital, India’s largest social enterprise bank. He is Chairman of Vivriti Asset Management and UC Inclusive Credit, which are pioneering firms working in bringing credit to underserved markets.

Narayan is co-founder and Fellow of the Takshashila Institution, with research interest in inclusive economics and topics of strategic national importance. He teaches an online graduate-level course on contemporary economics. He is the Chairman and co-founder of InKlude Labs, a social business enterprise working in the field of education and public health.

In 2018, Narayan finished a full 8-year term as Chairman of RBL Bank taking it to successful listing and beyond. Earlier, Narayan was the Country Head of Morgan Stanley India, leading all the Group’s businesses. He was the Head and lead portfolio manager of Morgan Stanley’s Global Emerging Markets and Global Asset Allocation teams, managing over $25 billion in assets. He began his career at Goldman Sachs.

Narayan received a B.Tech. in chemical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay and an M.B.A. from the University of Michigan. Narayan holds the Chartered Financial Analyst designation. He writes a fortnightly column titled “A Visible Hand” for The Mint Newspaper.

### Chairman & MD, SRF Ltd.

## Ashish Bharat Ram

Ashish Bharat Ram took over as the Managing Director of SRF Ltd. in January 2007. Subsequently, he was appointed Chairman and Managing Director on April 1, 2022. Under his leadership, SRF Ltd. has grown into a major global conglomerate with operations in four countries across India, Thailand, South Africa, and Hungary. Today, its businesses cover a diverse portfolio of Fluorochemicals, Specialty Chemicals, Packaging Films and Technical Textiles and command a market leadership position, both in India and overseas. The Company has a market capitalization of USD ~9 billion.

Prior to joining the SRF Group, Ashish worked with the American Express Bank in India and the Toyota Motor Corporation in Japan. Ashish led the successful divestment of SRF Finance to GE Capital in 1997.

Ashish has been studying the dynamics of family businesses for a while now and regularly speaks on the subject at Indian and global platforms. He has also authored articles on subjects related to India’s economic scenario and entrepreneurship in leading publications. Ashish has served as the Regional Chair for South Asia for the Young Presidents Organization (YPO) and is an active member of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII).

For his achievements in the areas of entrepreneurship and leadership, Ashish has been named India’s Best CEO in the emerging and mid-sized companies’ categories by Business Today, India’s leading business magazine in 2020 and 2023 respectively. Additionally, he was conferred the “Transformational Leader Award -Mid Cap company category” in 2020 by the Asian Centre for Corporate Governance & Sustainability. His sharp insights into the workings of SRF has enabled the company to win several laurels, including The Economic Times Family Business of the Year Award in the Large companies’ category in 2019 and the first-ever Moneycontrol Indian Family Business Award in the Giga category in 2021.

He holds a degree in Economics from Delhi University and earned an MBA from The Johnson Graduate School of Management, Cornell University.

Ashish is a single-digit handicap golfer and an avid follower of sports.

### Vice Chairman & Managing Director of Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services

## Ramesh Iyer

Mr. Ramesh Iyer, aged 65, holds a degree in Commerce and an MBA from Mumbai University and is an alumnus of several management and leadership programs conducted in India, the US, France, and China by institutions like IIM (Bangalore), Michigan Business School, Harvard Business School and IMD, Switzerland.

He is currently the Vice Chairman & Managing Director of Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services and President – Financial Services Sector & Member of Group Executive Board in Mahindra & Mahindra Limited.

Ramesh’s key mandate at Mahindra is to drive inclusive growth, aligned to our guiding belief of delivering rural prosperity. He has been instrumental in building Mahindra Finance into one of India’s leading rural finance companies, since 1994. The experience comes in handy when managing a team of over 30,000 employees, spread across 1,400 branches across the country. Ramesh’s efforts have led not only to the creation of a potentially global financial services powerhouse, but also supported the rapid expansion of our mobility and tractor businesses.

Ramesh manages the Financial Services Sector of the Mahindra Group which includes Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited and its subsidiaries, Mahindra Insurance Brokers Limited, Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited, Mahindra Asset Management Company Private Limited and Mahindra Trustee Company Private Limited. He also oversees the operations of Mahindra Finance USA, LLC., a U.S. joint venture with De Lage Landen Financial Services Inc., (DLLFS) a wholly owned subsidiary of the Rabobank Group.

Ramesh has been closely involved in the development of the country’s dynamic financial services sector, affecting policy change as the Chairman of the Finance Industry Development Council (FIDC). He is a member of the National Committee on Financial Inclusion and Digitisation of Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)and also serves as the Co-Chairman of the NBFC Committee of IMC Chamber of Commerce & Industry. He is also a member of the Banking & Finance Committee of the Bombay Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI), and the Taskforce of NBFCs of the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI). Apart from the Financial Services Sector, Ramesh is also on the Advisory Boards of various Educational Institutions like IITB-Washington University and Vidyalankar Institute of Technology – School of Management. He also serves on the boards of several Mahindra Group Companies.

Ramesh Iyer is a recipient of various prestigious awards like: ‘Asia Pacific Entrepreneurship Award (APEA) 2017 INDIA’, ‘Best CEO – Financial Services Sector Mid Cap’ awarded by Business Today, ‘CEO – FINANCIAL SERVICES’ at the CEO AWARDs organized by CEO India magazine and also featured among Business Today’s top 40 BFSI CEOs of India and Business World’s Most Valuable CEOs – 2019. The Company under his leadership was honoured with the Forbes India “Conscious Capitalist of the Year” Award 2016.

### Founder and former CEO of CaratLane

## Mithun Sacheti

Mithun Sacheti is the Founder and former CEO of CaratLane, India’s leading omni-channel jewellery brand. Over 15 years, he scaled the company to over ₹3,000 Cr in revenue with a 5-year CAGR of 50%, while maintaining capital efficiency and strong profitability (₹270 Cr EBITDA in FY24). His vision of blending digital innovation with offline retail set a new benchmark for accessible luxury in India. CaratLane’s strategic partnership with Titan Company Ltd. helped cement its status as the definitive 21st-century jewellery brand.

In 2023, Mithun exited CaratLane by selling his remaining stake to Titan for ₹4,620 Cr, valuing the company at ₹17,000 Cr. This marked India’s largest D2C e-commerce transaction and one of the country’s most successful entrepreneurial exits. Now an active investor and mentor, Mithun supports high-growth businesses across fintech, consumer goods, apparel, and infrastructure – offering both capital and operational insight.

Currently mentoring Oro, a fintech focused on unlocking the value of household gold, Mithun continues to back founders building transformational businesses. A jeweller by lineage and an operator by passion, he remains deeply involved in shaping the future of consumer and infrastructure sectors through innovation, design, and data-driven thinking.

We have an eclectic ecosystem of advisors, who come with invaluable experience across various business segments. Our investment team works symbiotically with our ecosystem to curate the best idea-based investments.

### Chairman & Managing Director

## Gopal Srinivasan

Gopal Srinivasan is the Chairman and Managing Director of TVS Capital Funds (TCF). TCF — a growth private equity platform set up in 2007, is the largest Indian rupee capital Fund in India, with a corpus of ₹2,000 Crores. Under the leadership of Gopal, the platform has invested in more than 30 businesses that include companies like Nykaa, RBL, National Stock Exchange (NSE), Indian Energy Exchange (IEX), GoDigit, Yubi and Five Star Business Finance.

Gopal is a third-generation member of the illustrious TVS Family; his entrepreneurial career spanning well over three decades, in which he has founded, steered and scaled up over 10 new ventures across diverse verticals.

Gopal also believes that the key for building the new India is to energize educational institutions. He has contributed significantly to his alma mater. Gopal is a member of University of Michigan’s Ross School of Business Advisory Board. Gopal was also associated as a Governing Board member of Great Lakes Institute of Management-Chennai, IFMR- Chennai and Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA), Chennai.

Gopal has played an extensive role in VC/PE industry bodies as well as regulatory policy landscape. He is a board member of the Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA). Gopal has been a member of SEBI’s Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC), since 2016 and he is also a board member of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), since its inception in Dec’20.

He actively involves in promoting start-ups and Founding member of The Chennai Angels, TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs), Chennai and Non-official member of National Start-up Advisory Council (NSAC) being formed by the DPITT

Gopal’s pursuit of excellence in creating an environment of intellectual and creative engagement in his hometown of Chennai led him to yet another initiative to bring together diverse groups of people under the auspices of the Chennai International Center (CIC). As its chairman, he has sought to develop CIC into a think tank that brings together a cornucopia of thought leaders from business, economy, policy, science, art, culture, and governing bodies.

- Chairman and Managing Director, TVS Capital Funds P Ltd
- Chairman of TVS Electronics Ltd
- Director on the Board of TVS & Sons and few other companies in and outside the TVS Group

Gopal is the Honorary Consul General for the Kingdom of Netherlands in Tamil Nadu, in recognition of his standing in the Community.

**Board Positions: Academics**

- Member, Ross School of Business Advisory Board at the University of Michigan, USA
- Former Chairman of the University of Michigan’s India Advisory Board
- Former member, Governing Councils at: Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA);
- Great Lakes Institute of Management; IFMR School of Management

**Board Positions: Private Equity / Venture Capital & Advisory Councils**

- Board member of Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH)

He brings deep financial expertise and significant understanding of consumer-related businesses to the PE operations.

Sundaram serves as an Independent Director on the eminent boards of Infosys, ACC, GSK Pharma India, Crompton Greaves Consumer, SBI General Insurance and Schneider Electric India Pvt Ltd. He is a two-time winner of the prestigious “CFO of the Year for FMCG Sector” award by CNBC TV18 (2006 and 2008). Also awarded as the “Best Independent Director in 2019” by Asian Centre for Corporate Governance and Sustainability in December 2020.

He is a Post Graduate of Management Studies (MMS), a Fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants, and an alumnus of the Harvard Business School.

### Managing Director, TVS Logistics

## R. Dinesh

Mr. R Dinesh, a fourth-generation TVS Family member, is a Commerce Graduate and an Associate Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and Institute of Cost & Works Accountants of India. He is the Executive Chairman of TVS Supply Chain Solutions, Director of TVS Mobility Group and Director of Ki Mobility Solutions that operates the myTVS brand across India.

Dinesh is the President of CII for FY 2023-24. He is also the Chairman of the CII Institute of Logistics and CII FBN (Family Business Network) India Chapter Council.

Dinesh has won many awards, including ‘Icon of the Year’ from ICT Academy of Tamil Nadu for the year 2018 and ‘Entrepreneur of the Year’ award for ‘Services’ category by Ernst & Young in 2017. He is also the recipient of TiECON’s ‘Next Gen Entrepreneur of the year 2014’ award and ‘Emerging Entrepreneur’ award by CII in 2010.

Dinesh founded TVS Supply Chain Solutions (earlier known as TVS Logistics) in 1995. The company, under his able leadership has grown multifold to become a billion-dollar company. TVS SCS employs around 18,000 people across the globe, with presence in over 25 countries. His other business Ki Mobility Solutions is the largest automotive aftermarket digital platform in India and offers integrated aftermarket services through online-to-offline (O-to-O) model.

Dinesh works closely with marquee investors like Exor International, Mitsubishi Corporation, etc. Currently, the companies under his management have a turnover of around USD 2 Billion and employ more than 25,000 people. He has been instrumental in expanding his companies’ operations globally and has set up subsidiaries in Sri Lanka, United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, Thailand, Bangladesh, United States of America, Singapore, China and Australia.

![](https://www.tvscapital.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/21-500x500.webp)

### Consultant and former Chief credit officer Asia, International Finance Corporation

## S. Balasubramanian

Balasubramanian, dearly addressed as Bala, is an experienced investment and risk professional who has worked for over 25 years in various capacities in the International Finance Corporation, a member of the World Bank Group. His diverse investment experience spans multiple regions and sectors in Emerging Markets and various roles including Chief Credit Officer for Asia, Portfolio Manager in East Asia, Country Manager in Turkey and Manager for strategy in Asia. He has also developed a successful track record of making and managing direct investments in Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

Prior to IFC, Balasubramanian has worked for a decade in the Tata Administrative Services, the elite management cadre of Tata Sons in India. In that capacity, he served as General Manager for Development for the Indian Hotels Company, which involved landmark Public-Private projects such as the Taj Mahal and Taj Palace Hotels in Delhi.

He has a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from IIT Delhi and a Post-Graduate Diploma from IIM Ahmedabad. As an Alfred P. Sloan Fellow at MIT, he completed a Master’s degree from MIT Sloan School of Management. He is also a qualified Cost and Management Accountant. He has attended the Executive Development Program of the World Bank Group, jointly sponsored by Harvard, Stanford and INSEAD business schools.

### Senior Advisor, Reliance Industries Limited

## Alok Agarwal

Alok is a transformational leader with a distinguished career spanning four decades as a senior finance professional and an ex-banker. He has played a pivotal role in defining the success story of the Reliance Group through his contributions relating to management of the Group’s financial resources, banking relationships and capital market transactions for over two decades, and establishing robust Governance and Risk Management programs.

Alok brings excellent leadership capability and management skills as well as strong ability to drive decision making.  He works collaboratively with both internal and external stakeholders, including the Promoters and Board, to drive the vision, strategy and growth of the organisation.

Alok joined Reliance Industries Limited (RIL)  in 1993 as Treasurer and was nominated as CFO in 2007.

In his role as CFO over 15 years, Reliance grew from assets of $25 bio and market cap of $45 billion to an asset base of over $200 billion and market cap of nearly $250 billion and is currently among the top 50 companies globally.

In this period, Reliance incubated two major global scale  businesses of Telecom and Retail and made major investments in its core energy business.

Alok was responsible for managing these investments, financing them and putting a world class governance framework around them. He has also received personal recognition as the best CFO in Asia.

Alok and his wife Shobha are deeply passionate about giving and have setup a private non-profit foundation to support education of young girls from underprivileged communities.

Alok holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from the premier business school in India – IIM-Ahmedabad, and a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from IIT-Kanpur.  Prior to joining RIL, he was with Bank of America for 12 years in a variety of roles.

**_A result oriented, strategic global leader working at senior leadership levels, with extensive experience in Emerging Markets, Financial Markets, Diversified Capital Raise, Risk Management, Strategy & Governance_**

### Chairman & Managing Director

## Gopal Srinivasan

Gopal Srinivasan is the Chairman and Managing Director of TVS Capital Funds (TCF). TCF — a growth private equity platform set up in 2007, is the largest Indian rupee capital Fund in India, with a corpus of ₹2,000 Crores. Under the leadership of Gopal, the platform has invested in more than 30 businesses that include companies like Nykaa, RBL, National Stock Exchange (NSE), Indian Energy Exchange (IEX), GoDigit, Yubi and Five Star Business Finance.

Gopal is a third-generation member of the illustrious TVS Family; his entrepreneurial career spanning well over three decades, in which he has founded, steered and scaled up over 10 new ventures across diverse verticals.

Gopal also believes that the key for building the new India is to energize educational institutions. He has contributed significantly to his alma mater. Gopal is a member of University of Michigan’s Ross School of Business Advisory Board. Gopal was also associated as a Governing Board member of Great Lakes Institute of Management-Chennai, IFMR- Chennai and Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA), Chennai.

Gopal has played an extensive role in VC/PE industry bodies as well as regulatory policy landscape. He is a board member of the Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA). Gopal has been a member of SEBI’s Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC), since 2016 and he is also a board member of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), since its inception in Dec’20.

He actively involves in promoting start-ups and Founding member of The Chennai Angels, TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs), Chennai and Non-official member of National Start-up Advisory Council (NSAC) being formed by the DPITT

Gopal’s pursuit of excellence in creating an environment of intellectual and creative engagement in his hometown of Chennai led him to yet another initiative to bring together diverse groups of people under the auspices of the Chennai International Center (CIC). As its chairman, he has sought to develop CIC into a think tank that brings together a cornucopia of thought leaders from business, economy, policy, science, art, culture, and governing bodies.

Gopal is the Honorary Consul General for the Kingdom of Netherlands in Tamil Nadu, in recognition of his standing in the Community.

### Founder and former CEO of CaratLane

## Mithun Sacheti

Mithun Sacheti is the Founder and former CEO of CaratLane, India’s leading omni-channel jewellery brand. Over 15 years, he scaled the company to over ₹3,000 Cr in revenue with a 5-year CAGR of 50%, while maintaining capital efficiency and strong profitability (₹270 Cr EBITDA in FY24). His vision of blending digital innovation with offline retail set a new benchmark for accessible luxury in India. CaratLane’s strategic partnership with Titan Company Ltd. helped cement its status as the definitive 21st-century jewellery brand.

In 2023, Mithun exited CaratLane by selling his remaining stake to Titan for ₹4,620 Cr, valuing the company at ₹17,000 Cr. This marked India’s largest D2C e-commerce transaction and one of the country’s most successful entrepreneurial exits. Now an active investor and mentor, Mithun supports high-growth businesses across fintech, consumer goods, apparel, and infrastructure – offering both capital and operational insight.

Currently mentoring Oro, a fintech focused on unlocking the value of household gold, Mithun continues to back founders building transformational businesses. A jeweller by lineage and an operator by passion, he remains deeply involved in shaping the future of consumer and infrastructure sectors through innovation, design, and data-driven thinking.

### Ex-Founding partner, Actis

## Mr. J. M. Trivedi

Mr. Trivedi has more than 35 years of experience in Indian financial services industry including 25 years with Indian venture capital and private equity Industry. He was associated with setting up one of the first venture capital firms in India viz. GVFL in 1990. He joined CDC, a UK based development finance institution, in 1997 to set up its Mumbai office. He was one the founding partners when Actis was spun out of CDC in 2004. He took over leadership of Actis South Asia in 2007. He was also a member of its global investment committee. He retired from Actis in 2015.

He graduated as a chemical engineer from the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay and holds a diploma in finance from Institute of Chartered Financial Analysts of India. He currently serves on the board of Bluepine Energy Private Limited which is building a clean energy platform with wind and solar assets of more than 3000mw capacity in India. He also serves on the board of trustees of CORO which is an NGO working with the marginalized communities in grass root leadership, women empowerment and gender sensitivity.
